studies.title: Great Pyramid of Giza — c. 2500 BCE
studies.caption: About 2500 BCE. Khufu's pyramid rises above the desert edge, its pale casing catching the light.
studies.prompt: Wide low desert approach; completed Great Pyramid with smooth pale limestone casing, square base and straight triangular faces, tiny Old Kingdom workers for scale. No later pyramids dominating, no camels.
